message.content:
\[
\frac{\sqrt{40\cdot 9}}{\sqrt{49}}
\]

First, multiply inside the numerator:

\[
40\cdot 9=360
\]

So the expression becomes:

\[
\frac{\sqrt{360}}{\sqrt{49}}
\]

Since \(\sqrt{49}=7\),

\[
\frac{\sqrt{360}}{7}
\]

Now simplify \(\sqrt{360}\):

\[
360=36\cdot 10
\]

so

\[
\sqrt{360}=\sqrt{36\cdot 10}=6\sqrt{10}
\]

Therefore,

\[
\frac{\sqrt{360}}{7}=\frac{6\sqrt{10}}{7}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{6\sqrt{10}}{7}\).
